goal: Make the feature-flags 'features off' @smoke test green and keep it green: confirm the telemetry + process-status silencing gate works on develop and add the spec to CI so it can never silently regress.
investigation: The reported failure (2x POST /telemetry/events + 1x GET /processes/status with both flags off) does NOT reproduce on current ado/develop. JAA-558 (feature-flags.ts + telemetry post() gate + useProcessStatus enabled gate) is present and correct. All /telemetry/* sends route through the single post() chokepoint (isTelemetryEnabled re-check) and all /processes/status reads through useProcessStatus's enabled:isProcessStatusEnabled(). Verified green 17+ times: isolation, full file, 4x-yes CPU load, config.js delivery delayed up to 3s, and CI-mirror IPv4 127.0.0.1 host. The all-defaults-ON symptom matches a state where feature-flags.ts is ABSENT (pre-JAA-558 / stale worktree) but the spec present — the most likely provenance of the author's local observation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: e2e/feature-flags.spec.ts 'features off' @smoke passes against the node mock: zero requests matching /telemetry/events|/telemetry/errors|/processes/status and zero matching console errors. The assertion is NOT weakened.
